title: A bi-directional deep learning architecture for lung nodule semantic segmentation

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《A bi-directional deep learning architecture for lung nodule semantic segmentation》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-8】This study aims to design and evaluate a deep learning (DL) algorithm for identifying pulmonary nodules (PNs) using the LUNA-16 dataset and examine the prevalence of PNs using DB-Net.
